summary: PR-1741 adds AppLog.debug to apps/baseline-payments/payments/logs.py, which is in the security_sensitive component payments.logging. CHG-5 requires a security_review approval from a security_reviewer, and the record has only a code_review, so the change must be rejected. The ticket, the independent code review on the head commit and the CI run on head are otherwise in order.
